<!-- pr-reviewer: 9d9df81ec47e02968ff1233d1722024f7f33c282 -->

Review by SlaveSession. Built locally in a reviewer worktree. The trial merge with main is clean.

Gate result: kernel sha256 tests 2 passed. app model_link suite 9 passed. app import suites (lib filter) 118 passed, 0 failed. Clippy is clean with -D warnings.

What I verified:
- One pass. `Hashing` hashes every byte it hands out. The ASCII rewind restarts the hash; any other seek is refused. The bytes after the last facet go into the same pass. I checked the BufReader law: bytes already in the window were hashed at hand-out, so the tail copy cannot double-hash or skip.
- The STL branch of `load_model_open_sourced` matches `load_model_open_within` step for step (same gate, same turn_outward, same Graded fields). The size check now uses the open handle, not a second metadata call. That is stronger than before.
- `hex_digest` is now `Sha256` over one piece, so the one-shot and the stream cannot drift apart. The split test pins every piece size around the 55/56/64-byte padding edges.
- The tests cover the ASCII path with a real ASCII fixture (cube.stl), the binary STL, OBJ and STEP digests, and a 3 MiB file in 1 MiB pieces.
- The decision file matches the code. The native and browser cfg wiring is clean.

Note: the body says the wasm build needs the one-line clock fix from #2709. That is outside this PR; this PR does not make the browser build worse.

Verdict: merge-ready. The maintainer merges a fork PR by hand.
